# AgentsFlow

> Universal AI agent manager for multi-platform development environments. Discover, orchestrate, monitor, and manage all your AI coding agents — Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, Cursor, Windsurf, Copilot — from a single control plane.

## What does AgentsFlow do?

AgentsFlow solves the fragmented agent management problem. Developers use 3-5 AI agents simultaneously, each with different configs, capabilities, and context windows. AgentsFlow provides a unified registry, health monitoring, task routing, and cross-agent context sharing.

## How to install AgentsFlow?

```bash
npm install -g agentsflow
```

## How to use AgentsFlow?

```bash
agentsflow scan          # discover all installed AI agents
agentsflow status        # check agent health and availability
agentsflow agents        # list capabilities per agent
agentsflow route "task"  # route task to best agent
agentsflow dashboard     # launch management UI
```

## How to use AgentsFlow as an MCP server?

Add to claude_desktop_config.json:
```json
{"mcpServers": {"agentsflow": {"command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "@agentsflow/mcp"]}}}
```

## What agents does AgentsFlow support?

Claude Code (~/.claude/), Codex CLI (~/.codex/), Google Antigravity (~/.gemini/), Cursor (~/.cursor/), Windsurf (~/.codeium/), GitHub Copilot (.github/), Warp (~/.warp/), Amp (~/.amp/), OpenHands, Goose.

## How does AgentsFlow relate to SkillFlow?

Sister projects in the Fluity ecosystem. SkillFlow manages skills (what agents know). AgentsFlow manages agents (the AI systems themselves). Together: complete multi-agent control.

## Packages

- @agentsflow/core: Discovery, registry, health, routing engine
- @agentsflow/cli: Interactive terminal interface
- @agentsflow/mcp: MCP server for cross-agent orchestration
- @agentsflow/sdk: SDK for building agent integrations
- @agentsflow/agents: Agent registry and definitions
- @agentsflow/registry: Public agent catalog
